Fixes dev-skill-up/pitboss#467

Head: 2f0008a626dfee9fb92746aebbc8acfd6f0117be

Done-when digest: a29f399577001ad7

## Plan

Each Done-when item of #467 word for word, with its evidence; the command row first, the CI pointers last. Every item is shown by tests, so each is a CI pointer; the run of the head is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/42989973082, the page of its `tests-3.13` entry is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/42989973082/job/130420164733 (workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests-3.13`, step `Run Nox`).

1. The head: `git rev-parse HEAD`.
2. When the newest `Opus ruling` comment of a PR follows its newest review and says `Ruling: do these steps`, the step `slots next` offers is "do the ruling's steps", and the approval of that earlier review is not a ground for the merge step. Demonstrated by: a test with a world holding an approving review followed by such a ruling, asserting the offered step. CI pointer: greppable `test_the_ruling_steps_are_offered_not_the_merge`, `test_the_offered_kind_is_do_the_rulings_steps`, `test_the_sweep_does_not_say_ready_to_merge_after_the_ruling` and, as the nearest input that must still merge, `test_an_approval_alone_is_merged` and `test_another_ruling_after_an_approval_does_not_void_it`; same run and page as above.
3. The printed brief for that step is the fix-round worker brief of the ruling (the same text as after a rejected Execution). Demonstrated by: a test asserting the brief's `PITBOSS-SLOT` line ends in `fix` and holds the ruling's comment URL. CI pointer: greppable `test_the_brief_is_the_fix_round_worker_brief_with_the_ruling`; same run and page as above.
4. A review that follows the ruling restores the approval. Demonstrated by: a test with a review after the ruling, asserting the merge step is offered again. CI pointer: greppable `test_a_review_after_the_ruling_restores_the_approval`; same run and page as above.

## Execution

- `flow.execution_gate`: an approving review whose newest readable ruling says `do these steps` and that no later review or push has followed gives the ruling's steps (`flowstate.ruling_unapplied`), not the merge; a later review restores the merge because the ruling is then applied.
- `flow.ruled_step` names the ruling's comment in the step of `do these steps` (`flowstate.ruling_address`, the former `unreadable_ruling_comment`, renamed), for the rejected-Execution path too, so both give one text; `briefheads` passes it and `brieftextfix.RULING_AT` prints it in the brief (kind RULING_STEPS, marker word `fix`).
- `pulls.approved` is false while the step is the ruling's steps, so the sweep prints no READY TO MERGE or AUTO MERGE OFF for the voided approval.
- Tests: `tests/test_ruling_voids.py`; the three existing expectations of the ruling's step now name the comment.
- Local: `pitboss nox` on the head (skills, lint, mypy and tests-3.13 all success), reported in the hand-back; CI's `Run Nox` is the proof of the whole suite.

Deviations: `pitboss nox` was run more than once, on three earlier heads (a test and then the sweep line failed; fixed between runs); the evidence block holds the head only, the nox result is in the hand-back.

## Evidence

```pitboss-expand sha256=6ddc667f5f9dbf11 head=2f0008a626dfee9fb92746aebbc8acfd6f0117be
$ git rev-parse HEAD
2f0008a626dfee9fb92746aebbc8acfd6f0117be
```

## How we got here

The review of head 2f0008a626dfee9fb92746aebbc8acfd6f0117be (https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/pull/468#issuecomment-6792127165) rejected the Execution on one finding about the Deviations line: it lists that `pitboss nox` was run once more on this head. There was no deviation: `pitboss nox` ran once on this head, which is the rule of one run per head, and the runs on earlier heads are on different commits. The Deviations line was wrong to list it. The brief line that should have prevented it is the Deviations rule of the worker brief (nox once per head). The prevention filed is dev-skill-up/pitboss#417 and #444 (the rule stated mechanically: one run per head, and runs on earlier heads are never a deviation). The review also gave "Plan: approved" beside "Execution: changes needed", a split verdict, so the whole PR counts as changes needed.

## Steps

1. Remove the nox sentence from the Deviations line in the PR body. Change no code and no head.
2. Lint the body and run `pitboss plan-check` at the head; post its output as a PR comment.
3. This is one fix round for this finding. The re-review covers only that body diff and gives one verdict for the whole PR.
